name: glm-dev
description: Development workflow plugin bundling two skills: glm-coding-agent (coding workflow discipline covering planning, implementation, verification and testing) and glm-fullstack-dev (Next.js 16 full-stack web development with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Prisma). Trigger for structured coding tasks and full-stack application builds; the discipline skill routes implementation work to the fullstack skill.

interface.shortDescription: Two development skills: the coding workflow discipline and the Next.js 16 full-stack build skill.
interface.longDescription: GLM Dev Workflow bundles the coding discipline and the full-stack build skill. glm-coding-agent enforces the structured coding workflow — planning, implementation, verification and testing — and routes concrete implementation work to glm-fullstack-dev, which builds Next.js 16 applications with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui and Prisma ORM, including database schemas, API routes and WebSocket support. The discipline skill governs when to plan, when to implement and how to verify; the fullstack skill owns the build details. Deliver projects under the user's workspace.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glm-dev plugin skills: <结构化编码任务 / Next.js 全栈应用开发>
